purpose: Authoritative/provenance registry for CiteJury citation rules. This file is static data only and is not loaded by the public website unless a future EP explicitly wires it into the UI.

authorities.name: Supreme Court of India neutral citation system
authorities.notes: Official Supreme Court neutral citation lookup exists and remains the user verification route for generated SCI neutral citation tokens.

authorities.name: Supreme Court Reports / e-SCR
authorities.notes: Official SCR/e-SCR portal is a primary verification source for Supreme Court judgments and neutral citation data.

authorities.name: Supreme Court of India neutral citation press note, 23 February 2023
authorities.notes: Useful for provenance but should be cross-checked against Supreme Court-hosted notices before final rule implementation.

authorities.name: Supreme Court neutral citation format notice, July 2023
authorities.notes: Official notice states Supreme Court neutral citation format uses year + INSC + sequence number, e.g. 2023INSC1, and describes phased implementation from July 06, 2023.

authorities.name: Oxford University Standard for Citation of Legal Authorities (OSCOLA)
authorities.notes: Oxford Law Faculty is the primary source for OSCOLA. EP-034 should replace OSCOLA-like output with scoped, tested OSCOLA rules.

authorities.name: OSCOLA 4th edition PDF
authorities.notes: Detailed rule source for 4th edition examples and edge cases.

authorities.name: OSCOLA quick reference guide
authorities.notes: Concise source for primary-source order and common examples.

authorities.name: Standard Indian Legal Citation working draft
authorities.notes: Potential Indian citation framework. Because the available source is a working draft, CiteJury must label any SILC-derived rules carefully.

authorities.name: Indian Law Institute citation style PDF
authorities.notes: Institutional legal citation guidance; useful for comparing Indian academic citation practice, not a universal court authority.

authorities.name: SCC Online / Eastern Book Company
authorities.notes: Publisher source for SCC law reports and legal research. CiteJury uses only a narrow common core SCC component pattern and does not claim full editorial SCC style coverage.
